What every prophet taught

One command to do good

Justice, honesty, keeping trusts, kindness to parents: one divine command, heard in many books.

Ask people of any faith, or of none, what a good person does. Be fair. Tell the truth. Give back what was left in your care. Be kind to your parents. The Quran gives these as God's command, and the books below say them in their own words. That shared sense of right is one order, written on the heart and spoken by the prophets.

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

Quran · An-Nahl 16:90

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا۟ ٱلْأَمَـٰنَـٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا۟ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh commands you to render trusts to whom they are due and when you judge between people to judge with justice. Excellent is that which Allāh instructs you. Indeed, Allāh is ever Hearing and Seeing.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:58

﴿وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:23

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

O you who have believed, fear Allāh and be with those who are true.

Quran · At-Tawbah 9:119

You might ask

QuestionDid earlier peoples receive these commands?
AnswerYes. The Quran records a covenant with the Children of Israel: worship God alone, be good to parents, kin, orphans and the poor, and speak kindly to people.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:83
QuestionWhat does keeping a trust mean?
AnswerGive back what was left in your care to those it belongs to, and judge fairly. The Quran joins both in one command.Quran · An-Nisa 4:58
QuestionMust I be fair to people I dislike?
AnswerYes. The Quran says dislike of a people is no reason to turn from justice, and it calls justice nearest to reverence.Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:8

Be fair, be true, keep what is trusted to you, and honour those who raised you.
